root_cause: After cron-owner consolidation, commercial heartbeat job 154 still failed with pg_cron job startup timeout while it was the only POWERHOUSE cron starting on the heartbeat minute. Production pg_cron uses client/libpq job connections, so the business heartbeat remained coupled to a proven unreliable connection-start path.
prevention: Schedule the heartbeat externally through Netlify at offset minutes, hand execution to a protected background function, and execute the database transaction through a Supabase Edge runner using IPv4 Supavisor transaction transport with one connection per isolate. Keep the legacy pg_cron heartbeat until external durable readback is proven, then retire it.
